newsitem.title: UK: Crest Nicholson says bullish on current yr.
newsitem.headline: Crest Nicholson says bullish on current yr.

text.p: British residential housing and property development group Crest Nicholson Plc said it was expecting "excellent" figures for the first half of its current financial year.

John Matthews, chairman of Crest Nicholson, told shareholders at its annual general meeting that the good results would be achieved despite fears of an expected interest rate hike and a pause in market caused by the coming elections.
"Our commercial property and construction activities are performing well but our housing operation is currently producing outstanding figures," Matthews said.
He said the company was experiencing "considerable success" in replenishning land stocks at good margins.
"Currently, our reservations are running some 30 percent ahead of the equivalent period last year and we are also seeing significant sales price improvements in most of our regions," Matthews said.
